title: Count Cluster Nodes via Async Messages
description_html:
Given the root_node of a cluster, count the number of nodes in the cluster using only sendAsyncMessage() (ask a node for its neighbors) and receiveMessage() (collect replies). Nodes are reached by message-passing — you traverse outward from the root.

Follow-ups

  • Return the structure of the cluster (the adjacency / topology) instead of just the count.
  • If messages may fail and be retried, how do you keep the result correct?

Input / Output

Input: root_node. Output: the number of nodes reachable in the cluster.

Test Cases

tree with 3 nodes   -> 3
single node         -> 1
chain of 5 nodes    -> 5

This is concurrent graph traversal with dedup (cf. LC 1242 / 1236). See Notes for traversal, retry-idempotency, the structure follow-up, and the trio.
